mainEntity.name: What is Web3 investor relations PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the communications work around a token or equity raise: shaping the narrative so it reads well to the VCs deciding whether to write a check, and to the journalists deciding whether to cover the close. That means a one-line thesis, investor-ready framing and an embargoed announcement timed to the round, not a generic wire release. Shilika Jain has run this for raises including MANTRA Chain's $11M round, which became a CoinDesk exclusive with a Middle East RWA angle.

mainEntity.name: How much does fundraising PR for a Web3 raise cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator runs investor relations PR for $5K–$12K per month on an ongoing basis. A single raise, from pre-announce to close coverage, typically runs as a $15K–$40K sprint over four to eight weeks. That is well below a $15K–$45K/month traditional agency retainer for comparable senior-level work.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets actually cover a Web3 funding round?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto and finance: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant, Bloomberg. Mainstream where the raise size or angle warrants it: Forbes, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: TokenPost and BloomingBit (Korea), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Which outlet fits depends on round size, investor names and the region your next raise or listing targets.

mainEntity.name: When should we start investor relations PR before a raise closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six to eight weeks before the intended close, so there is time to build the narrative, brief journalists under embargo and line up investor quotes that will actually clear legal. Starting the week of close usually means settling for a wire blast instead of an exclusive.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your raise story, or book a 30-minute call to plot the announcement together.
